recipes.title: Crimson: Edwin Norena Purple Honey
recipes.notes: Own recipe, brewed on the operator's Aiden. Tasting notes: blackberry, molasses, lemongrass. Grown at 1650 masl. 30 g at 450 ml. Ode Gen 2, standard burrs: start at 5 for 450 ml (range 5-5.1), 5.1-6 for 451-750 ml, 6-7 for 751-1000 ml. Doses: 40 g at 600 ml, 50 g at 750 ml, 66.7 g at 1000 ml. Title spells the producer without the tilde because profile titles the brewer accepts are ASCII only.
